take her and goe thy waies, and let her be the wife of thy
lords ſonne, as our Lord hath ſpoken. † Which when A-
brahams ſeruant heard, falling downe he adored our Lord
to the grounde. † And taking forth veſſel of ſiluer, and
gold, and garments, gaue them to Rebecca for a preſent.
To her brothers alſo, and to her mother he offred giftes.
